correctness.rationale: Exact local Boolean equivalence on 3-column windows gives a 16-state transfer expression for each polynomial. A reproducible exact integer-polynomial program verifies 16 matrix residual identities. By Cayley-Hamilton, these imply every later residual; initial 5 coefficients plus the order-6 case establish the rational formula for all n. Separately, a cross-cut matching count and a two-case column argument prove the complete minimum-set classification. Direct graph-based exhaustive checks through n=9 agree, but are corroboration only. See RESULT.md and verify.py.

value.rationale: Refines a recently solved exact graph-product optimization problem into a complete cardinality-by-cardinality census on a standard infinite family. The reduced order-five rational recurrence allows all counts without exponential subset enumeration, and the parity-sharp 2/4 optimum multiplicity classification has a clean structural explanation. The central question is motivated by load-limited facility placement and a real gap between a minimum value and the set of admissible configurations; no downstream theorem is needed.
